scope: Original Chinese mobile-web teaching example; fictional civic/community content. Not a native app.
method: Viewport-exact PNGs via headless Chrome rendering the page inside a fixed 390x844 iframe (true CSS pixels); interactive flow asserted in a CDP-driven browser against the same iframe.
checks: document.scrollWidth == 390 in list and large-text (no horizontal overflow)
category filter narrows to 2 records; combined category+query reaches empty state; clear restores 8
open record shows detail with matching title; back returns to list
detail left edges align: back / title / save all at x=18
same-category related entries render and clicking one opens that record
detail save bar is position:sticky at bottom and stays reachable while scrolling
favorite toggles aria-pressed and persists to localStorage; survives back re-render and reload
large-text scales chrome too: search 19px, brand 24px, chips/count/back/save enlarged; still no overflow
variant A/B and large-text toggles update documentElement dataset
no console errors or warnings during the flow
